newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - C.BANK OFFICIAL RESERVES UP IN MARCH.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - C.BANK OFFICIAL RESERVES UP IN MARCH.

text.p: Lithuania's central bank said on Monday that its official reserves rose in March to $813.9 million from $795.0 million at the end of February.
The bank said in a statement that its convertable currency reserves in the month rose to $747.9 million from $726.7 million.
It added that its gold reserves remained unchanged at $62.0 million and that its holdings of SDRs fell to $4.0 million from $6.3 million.
